name: Tokugawa Ieyasu
source:
Hobby: Reading How-To Books
Special Skill: Making Medicines
Charm Point: His fluffy soft hair

An ambitious warrior who has fomed an alliance with Nobunaga. He is determined and competitive, and has no time for anyone he deems as weak. Behind his obstinate attitude hides a tragic past.

"Do as you please. I have no interest in weaklings like you."
